title: Slot
description: A placeholder a device is plugged into. The product promise is that a user binds devices to slots and the rest follows, so a slot is the unit that makes a pack configurable without a pack author knowing which house it lands in.

accepts_domains.description: Home Assistant domains a binding may use, e.g. `light`.

required.description: True when a room of a type providing this slot cannot be set up without it.

source_repos.description: Every repo whose usage produced this slot.

examples.description: At least one, and at least two different repos when source_repos has more than one.

reuse_status_code.description: Copied from the licence record so the example is auditable without a join.

raw_ids.description: Raw records this example was drawn from. Empty is permitted, but only with a description.

description.description: Our own words. Required when raw_ids is empty, and required in place of an entity reference when the source does not grant reuse.
